kind: dynamically linked ELF execution through the in-memory loader (emulator and real device)

mechanism.main: PT_LOAD segments mapped anonymously at base 0x1000000000 with MAP_FIXED
mechanism.interpreter: the signed guest /lib/ld-musl-aarch64.so.1 is read and its segments mapped anonymously at base 0x2000000000
mechanism.auxv: AT_PHDR/AT_ENTRY point at the main image; AT_BASE = interpreter base; execution starts at the interpreter entry
mechanism.dynamicLinking: musl ld performs the main PIE relocation and loads libc.musl-aarch64.so.1 through the signed guest bindings
